name: Achievement Milestones
description: The long tail that gives a number somewhere to go. An achievement watches a declared statistic against a threshold and fires exactly once, and in this genre it usually pays: achievement multipliers are how an idle game rewards breadth rather than depth. Firing once is the contract that matters — a milestone that re-fires on reload turns a save into a printing press — so grants are recorded against the profile rather than the session. Hidden achievements are supported and are shown as locked silhouettes rather than omitted, because a player who cannot see that something exists cannot go looking for it.

inputs.name: achievements
inputs.description: Definitions: id, watched statistic, threshold, reward and whether it is hidden. Required.

inputs.name: rewardMultiplierPer
inputs.description: Production multiplier granted per achievement earned. Small, because breadth should matter without dwarfing the tier ladder.

inputs.name: showHiddenAsLocked
inputs.description: Whether hidden achievements appear as silhouettes rather than being omitted.

outputs.name: progressById
outputs.description: Fractional progress toward each unearned achievement.
